transport.accepted_identity_rule: Only an observed response header beginning exactly with [claude-code:sonnet was accepted.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: article-level MDP, return, value, Bellman, first-use terminology and learning-flow audit

findings.claim: The article needed to distinguish a finite terminal episode from a continuing return, and true termination from time-limit truncation in a bootstrapped target.
findings.current_state: The return explorer is explicitly a finite terminal episode. The article now shows episodic and continuing return formulas and a separate Korean-annotated terminal-versus-time-limit target.

findings.claim: The first-use learning vocabulary around backup and credit needed a Korean functional gloss.
findings.current_state: The article explains backup as the operation that folds next-state value into the current estimate and describes credit as a responsibility signal carried to earlier decisions.

accepted_reviews.result: The public numeric examples and MDP/Bellman control semantics passed the primary review.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: single article, policy-gradient derivation, baseline, actor-critic and GAE terminology

findings.claim: GAE appeared before Generalized Advantage Estimation was expanded and functionally introduced.
findings.current_state: The first use and section heading now expand Generalized Advantage Estimation(GAE) and explain the residual-weighted bias-variance role.

findings.claim: Bootstrap and TD residual lacked Korean first-use glosses at the actor-critic transition.
findings.current_state: The prose now introduces bootstrap(부트스트랩), and the FormulaNote defines the one-step TD residual as 시간차 잔차.

rejected_claims.claim: A long policy-gradient display formula necessarily overflows its box.
rejected_claims.reason: The shared MathFormula component uses ResizeObserver-based display auto-fit, max-width constraints and overflow hiding. A source-only review cannot establish a browser overflow defect.

rejected_claims.claim: The baseline section ambiguously claims that the true gradient itself has variance.
rejected_claims.reason: The adjacent lab explicitly labels the measured quantity as sample-gradient variance, so the statement is scoped to the estimator rather than the exact expectation.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: single article, MC/TD/lambda return, SARSA/Q-learning, DQN/Double DQN and implementation vocabulary

findings.claim: Replay and function approximator were used before an accessible first-use definition.
findings.current_state: The article now introduces the replay buffer as stored past transitions and function approximator as the Q network before relying on those terms.

findings.claim: N in the finite lambda-return was not defined in the nearby symbol note.
findings.current_state: The FormulaNote defines N as the maximum return horizon remaining from the current time to terminal T.

rejected_claims.claim: The lambda-return display necessarily causes horizontal overflow.
rejected_claims.reason: The shared responsive formula auto-fit prevents a source-only declaration of browser overflow; no screenshot defect was supplied by this pass.

accepted_reviews.result: Signs, masks, SARSA/Q-learning targets, DQN/Double DQN network roles and numeric examples passed.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: single article, Bayes belief chronology, state-estimation acronyms, evidence notation and numeric consistency

findings.claim: NIS, EKF, UKF and RSSM appeared without complete first-use expansions.
findings.current_state: The article expands Normalized Innovation Squared, Extended Kalman Filter, Unscented Kalman Filter and Recurrent State-Space Model with Korean glosses.

findings.claim: The belief Viz labeled evidence as P(o), while the derivation used Z at the next time step without an explicit mapping.
findings.current_state: The lab now labels Z_(t+1)=P(o_(t+1)|b_t,a_t), and the FormulaNote connects that normalizer to the evidence term.

accepted_reviews.result: Prediction-correction-normalization chronology and worked Bayes arithmetic passed.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: single article, Dyna, World Models, MuZero, Dreamer, model-bias units and acronym audit

findings.claim: RSSM was not expanded at first use.
findings.current_state: The Dreamer section now expands Recurrent State-Space Model(RSSM, 순환 상태공간 모델).

findings.claim: MDN-RNN and MCTS were not expanded at first use.
findings.current_state: The article now expands Mixture Density Network RNN and Monte Carlo Tree Search at their first explanatory use.

findings.claim: The model-bias lab combined acceleration in m/s squared with a horizon in abstract steps without stating the sample interval.
findings.current_state: The lab and specification now fix one model step to delta t = 1 second and state the unit boundary.

rejected_claims.claim: The Dreamer lambda-return is incorrect because it uses v_t rather than v_(t+1).
rejected_claims.reason: The cited peer-reviewed DreamerV3 Nature publication prints the same r_t, c_t, v_t recurrence. The article retains that publication convention and explains that implementations assigning transition reward to the next-state index may shift the notation by one step.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: supplemental content-spec, Viz control and static responsive-risk audit
accepted_reviews.result: Public numeric oracle, control contract and static responsive semantics passed within the narrow prompt scope. This pass did not compare the hidden fixture against public values.

accepted_reviews.review_scope: explicit cross-file hidden-transfer versus public-Viz fixture separation audit

findings.claim: The hidden transfer fixture duplicated public histories, rewards, gamma, Q values, policy probability, values, advantages and Bellman defaults, so it tested recall of the visible examples rather than transfer.
findings.current_state: The hidden fixture now uses histories 0->2 and 3->2, rewards [2,-1,3,0,4], gamma .8, safe/risk probability branches .4/.6, policy .7/.3 and terminal-versus-time-limit V=2.5. Its recomputed oracle is G0=4.7584, G1=3.448, truncated=5.5776, Q=2.9/1.92, V=2.606 and A=.294/-.686. Old public values remain only under an explicitly labeled Public Viz numeric oracle and are forbidden for hidden scoring.
